title: trade
summary: The complete Benilla trade wire and presentation seam is implemented: exact request decline verbs, strict 0..22 status tails, the fixed 444-byte seven-slot extended snapshot with signed charges, refusal-state closure versus non-closing ONLY_CONJURED, MPQ-authored red refusal feedback, and proposed-enchant spell resolution for the non-traded seventh slot. Live two-client verification remains.

openItems.text: CMSG_BUSY_TRADE and CMSG_IGNORE_TRADE are never sent - there is no decline path for an incoming trade request (Benilla's busy/ignore pair)
openItems.resolution: Implemented Benilla's empty-body CMSG_BUSY_TRADE and CMSG_IGNORE_TRADE verbs. Incoming ignored initiators are declined without opening a modal; requests received while an invitation or trade is active and explicit invitation Cancel send BUSY. Open-trade Cancel remains CMSG_CANCEL_TRADE. TradeProtocolClinicalChecks pins opcodes, empty bodies, decision precedence, and call-site wiring.

openItems.text: SMSG_TRADE_STATUS refusal codes close the trade state with Benilla's terminal/refusal split, and ONLY_CONJURED correctly leaves it open, but Busy(0/5), NoTarget(6), TargetTooFar(10), WrongFaction(11), IgnoreYou(14), stunned/dead/logout (15-20), TrialAccount(21), and OnlyConjured(22) still produce no red user-facing error text
openItems.resolution: Mapped every refusal status to the archived Interface/FrameXML/GlobalStrings.lua key and exact fallback, including partner substitution for busy/ignore, then routed the result through the existing law-positioned UIErrorsFrame. Clinical checks pin the complete refusal vocabulary and production route.

openItems.text: CloseWindow(12) result/itemLimitCategory tail and the ONLY_CONJURED slot byte are not read (harmless per-packet, but the codes' payloads are unused)
openItems.resolution: Added strict TradePackets.ParseStatus with the exact BEGIN_TRADE raw-guid, CLOSE_WINDOW u32/u8/u32, and ONLY_CONJURED u8 tails plus trailing-byte rejection. GameLoop now consumes the typed packet; clinical goldens pin all three tail forms and the non-closing ONLY_CONJURED behavior.

openItems.text: TRADE_STATUS_EXTENDED's enchant_spell_id header field is read and discarded - the enchant-through-trade (non-traded 7th slot spell) display is unimplemented
openItems.resolution: TradePackets retains enchant_spell_id per side. The seventh slot resolves it through Spell.dbc and replaces the ordinary non-traded label with the proposed spell name in Benilla's green; zero retains Will Not Be Traded. Clinical checks pin both states.

openItems.text: Live two-client verification: ignored/busy/explicit invitation declines use their distinct paths; every server refusal displays the localized red error and applies the correct close/keep-open state; cancelling an open trade still closes normally; a proposed enchant replaces slot seven's non-traded label with the green spell name.
